one.title: Plan your money, month by month
one.body: See where your money goes and what is left, in CAD and FCFA, side by side.

two.title: Budgets that keep you on track
two.body: Set a limit for each category and watch the bar fill. A warning shows before you go over.

three.title: Goals and bills, together
three.body: Save toward what matters and never miss a recurring bill.

authCta: Sign in or create an account
noCloud: Cloud sync is not set up in this build, so accounts are unavailable here. The demo works fully offline.

illustration.a11y: Illustration of a plan card, a budget bar and a savings goal ring
